title: The Drive facet request
prompt: A team asks for a custom Google Drive connector so they can filter by Clinic ID. Drive is already connected natively. What do you recommend?

options.text: Build a custom Drive connector that pushes Clinic ID as a custom property.
options.feedback: This duplicates a supported connector and moves support to you. Native and custom connectors use separate namespaces, so filters and agents scoped to one do not see the other.

options.text: Keep the native Drive connector and attach Clinic ID with Custom Metadata.
options.feedback: Right. Use an existing connector before building a new one. Custom Metadata attaches to documents from any datasource, including native connectors, without re-indexing.

options.text: Ask users to type the Clinic ID into every file title.
options.feedback: This pushes a data-model problem onto users and still creates no filterable field.

takeaway: The cheapest connector is the one you do not have to build.
